covenants.quote: Business Associate shall not, and shall ensure that no Subcontractor shall, access, view, create, receive, maintain, transmit, store or process PHI from or at any location outside the United States, whether directly or by remote access.
covenants.impact: This domestic performance restriction is limited by Section 1.2 to Protected Health Information handled specifically for Harrington and does not restrict the performance of services for CareBridge Clinics from India.
